messages:
sara (sales): FYI handing over pen-test artifacts to AcmeCorp. They requested full evidence bundle + checksums and a remediation timeline by EOD Friday. Can someone take ownership of upload + checksum verification + redaction? Bucket path we're planning: s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-2026/

linda (security): I can own checksum verification and redaction review. Need a manifest (filenames + sha256) and a list of files that may contain PII/screenshots.

sara (sales): Sending manifest snippet below — full dump will be uploaded to the bucket shortly. Also note: customer will only accept signed checksums (sha256).

sara (sales): ```
manifest.csv
acme-pt-report.pdf,8d969eef6ecad3c29a3a629280e686cff8fabd2f
webscan-results.json,3b7a3d5d7c3a2e1b2c4f4a6e1f3a8b2c4e6d7a8b
screenshots.zip,9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2
server-logs.tar.gz,2c26b46b68ffc68ff99b453c1d30413413422a6a
```

jay (eng-sre): I will validate after upload. @sam can you confirm the bucket will be private and versioned? I'll run a quick integrity check and post results here. Also recommend running `clamav`/malware scan on the tarball.

sam (ops): Confirmed: bucket will be private, versioning enabled, server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) with Redwood KMS key. I will upload to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-2026/ and attach a read-only presigned link for the customer once checksums verified. I will also kick off the AV scan and paste results. ETA for upload: 90m.

mike (legal): Quick note — any screenshots containing customer email addresses or internal hostnames must be redacted before we hand to Acme's external review team. If redaction is required we need to delay presigned link until redaction is done. Linda, can you flag any files?

linda (security): Will flag. From cursory look: screenshots.zip contains two files that have console screenshots with possible usernames. I'll mark them in the manifest as [REDACT]. Updated lines: 
```
screenshots.zip,9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2,[REDACT]: console-1.png,console-2.png
```
I'll do redaction pass after upload and confirm.

upload-bot: upload complete: 35 objects, total 124MB, path: s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-2026/ (versioned)

jay (eng-sre): Verified checksums against manifest: all files matched except webscan-results.json (mismatch). I re-downloaded and re-hashed — apparently upload was partial for that file. @sam can you re-upload webscan-results.json (same filename) and confirm new sha256?

sam (ops): Re-uploaded webscan-results.json. New sha256: 3b7a3d5d7c3a2e1b2c4f4a6e1f3a8b2c4e6d7a8b (matches manifest). AV scan: clean.

linda (security): Redaction pass complete for console-1.png and console-2.png — redacted copies uploaded with suffix .redacted.png. I updated manifest and created a redaction log (redaction-log.txt) describing removed fields.

sara (sales): Owners and next steps: Linda — checksum verification + redaction log (done). Jay — integrity verification and timestamped proof (please paste the sha256-check results). Sam — presigned link creation and transfer record. Mike/legal — confirm redaction log satisfies policy.

jay (eng-sre): Here are the verification entries (sha256 + timestamp):
```
acme-pt-report.pdf 8d969eef6ecad3... verified 1918000220
webscan-results.json 3b7a3d5d7c3a2e... verified 1918000285
screenshots.zip 9f86d081884c7d65... verified 1918000300
server-logs.tar.gz 2c26b46b68ffc68... verified 1918000315
```

mike (legal): Redaction log reviewed. Good to go from legal. No additional NDAs required for this bundle.

sam (ops): Presigned link created and emailed to Acme security contact (one-time, expires in 7 days). Transfer record: transfer-1918000330.csv uploaded to internal audit bucket.

sara (sales): Thanks team. I'll reply to Acme with the bundle link, attached checksums, redaction log, and a proposed remediation timeline: initial triage complete by Monday, prioritized fixes ETA by Wednesday, and patch rollouts by next Friday. If they push for earlier we'll escalate. :thumbsup:

linda (security): Noted. If customer needs proof-of-fix we should request CVE/issue IDs or PR links in the remediation report.

sara (sales): Will ask for PRs/issue links when I confirm their acceptance criteria. Closing thread once Acme acknowledges receipt.

sam (ops): Acked. Closing on our side after audit record retention confirmed.
